name: Open WebUI
description: A ChatGPT-style chat for local models (works with Ollama).
notes: Install Ollama too (below) and pull a model; the first account you create is the admin.
compose:
services:
  open-webui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main
    container_name: open-webui
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:8080"
    environment:
      OLLAMA_BASE_URL: "http://host.docker.internal:11434"
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}/data:/app/backend/data
